此刻，吴姜又进入了令牌里的空间，看着兑换中心里的东西眼馋。只是里面的东西，就一点不好，太耗贡献点了，以他现在还倒欠100点的家底，连件最基础的法器碎片都碰不起。

倒是修炼上总算有了起色，城隍老祖宗传授的《幽冥炼魂诀》顺利的入了门，不禁又感叹了一番：自己果然是个修炼天才。

如今的他，精气神比以前好了不止一个档次，五感也变得异常敏锐，甚至能隐约捕捉到空气中游离的微弱阴气。这既是炼魂功法入门的标志，也是阴差必备的基础本事。

按照地府的境界划分，吴姜现在应该是鬼兵境。理论上来说，对付那些最普通的孤魂野鬼，压根不在话下。

可理论归理论，吴姜心里半点底都没有，他连真鬼长啥样都没见过，真要是撞上了，不知道会不会被吓的尿了裤子。

这一周里，吴姜除了修炼，就是琢磨鬼物分类大全了。

按大全里所说，鬼物里最弱的就是游魂，大多是刚死不久的枉死者，怨气不重，攻击性很小，最多就是吓吓人的程度。

再往上就是怨灵，因积怨而生，执念极深，大多会纠缠与自己相关的人。据介绍，资深的鬼兵境对付起来，还是很轻松的。当然，这里指的不是吴姜这种刚入门的半吊子。

怨灵之上是厉鬼，阴气浓郁，凶性十足，得鬼兵境往上的鬼卒才能应对。

比起厉鬼更厉害的，还有恶鬼，鬼将，鬼帅，鬼王，对于吴姜这种还没见过鬼的，实在想象不出来，会有多厉害。

至于那些寿终正寝、了无牵挂的人，就用不上他们这种阴差出手了，自有城隍庙的专职鬼差负责接引，送往地府轮回。

这天傍晚，吴姜正在陪着爷爷吃饭，他准备再住几天就回省城了。也该准备找工作了，毕竟，鬼差也不能不吃饭不是。

突然，吴姜的心神悸动了一下。

吴姜了悟，这是地方来新的通知了。顾不得爷爷就在身边，随手就召出了阴差令牌。

心神浸入之间，一条全新的任务信息涌入了脑海。

“三等鬼差吴姜，请于12个时辰之内，收服苍名县城郊公路上的游魂。”

吴姜手心瞬间冒了汗，虽说这一周把鬼物大全摸得差不多了，功法也入了门，但他从未真正接触过鬼物，紧张自然是正常的。

老爷子见他脸色发白、神色慌张，当即放下筷子，眉头一皱，问道：“怎么了小姜？出了什么事了？”

吴姜也不藏着掖着，连忙把地府派发的抓鬼任务一五一十地告诉了爷爷。

反正之前泄露地府的惩罚已经挨过了，这会儿他也不在乎了，先让老爷子帮忙拿个主意，才是重中之重。

老爷子听完，脸色也严肃起来，指尖轻轻摩挲着桌面，对于孙子即将第一次见鬼，也是相当的慎重。

他摸着下巴沉思片刻后，眼睛突然一亮，一拍大腿：“小姜，上次城隍老祖宗有没有说过，他什么时候升迁去当府城隍？”

吴姜仔细回想了一下，摇了摇头：“老祖宗只说快要升迁了，没说具体时间。”

“那这不就妥了！”老爷子精神一振，“阴间的办事效率，未必比阳间快多少，这才过去一周，老祖宗肯定还没走！咱们再去求求他，怎么着也得让他给你整点保命的手段！”

At this moment, Wu Jiang entered the space in the token again and looked at the things in the exchange center with greed.It's just that the things inside are not good at all. It consumes too many contribution points. With his family's current debt of 100 points, he can't even touch the most basic magic weapon fragments.

However, there was finally some improvement in his cultivation. I successfully mastered the "Netherworld Soul Refining Technique" taught by the ancestor of Chenghuang. I couldn't help but sigh again: I am indeed a cultivation genius.

Today, his energy and energy are much better than before, and his five senses have become extremely sharp, and he can even vaguely capture the faint Yin Qi floating in the air.This is not only a sign of entry into the soul refining technique, but also a basic skill necessary for Yin Zai.

According to the realms of the underworld, Wu Jiang should be in the ghost soldier realm now.Theoretically speaking, dealing with the most common lonely ghosts is not a problem at all.

But theory is theory, and Wu Jiang doesn't have any confidence in his heart. He has never even seen what a real ghost looks like. If he really bumps into it, he doesn't know if he will be so scared that he wets his pants.

During this week, apart from practicing, Wu Jiang also studied the classification of ghosts.

According to the encyclopedia, the weakest ghosts among ghosts are wandering spirits, most of which are those who have just died in vain. They have little resentment and little aggression. At most, they are frightening.

Further up are the resentful spirits, who are born from grudges and have deep obsessions. Most of them will entangle the people related to them.According to reports, it is still very easy for experienced ghost soldiers to deal with them.Of course, this does not refer to a dabbler like Wu Jiang who has just started.

Above the resentful spirits are fierce ghosts, which are full of Yin energy and full of ferocity. Only ghost soldiers with a higher level of ghost soldiers can deal with them.

There are more powerful ghosts than ghosts, including evil ghosts, ghost generals, ghost commanders, and ghost kings. For people like Wu Jiang who have never seen ghosts, they really can't imagine how powerful they can be.

As for those people who have died and have nothing to worry about, there is no need for them to take action. The full-time ghost messengers from the Chenghuang Temple are responsible for picking them up and sending them to the underworld for reincarnation.

That evening, Wu Jiang was having dinner with his grandfather. He planned to stay for a few more days before returning to the provincial capital.It's time to prepare to find a job. After all, even a ghost job has to eat.

Suddenly, Wu Jiang's heart palpitated.

Wu Jiang realized that this was a new notice from the place.Not caring that grandpa was by his side, he casually summoned the Yin difference token.

While his mind was immersed, a brand new mission information flooded into his mind.

"Third-class ghost agent Wu Jiang, please subdue the wandering spirits on the suburban roads of Cangming County within 12 hours."

Wu Jiang's palms suddenly became sweaty. Although he had almost touched the encyclopedia of ghosts this week and had mastered the techniques, he had never really come into contact with ghosts, so it was normal to be nervous.

When the old man saw that his face was pale and he looked panicked, he immediately put down his chopsticks, frowned, and asked, "What's wrong, Xiao Jiang? What happened?"

Wu Jiang didn't hide it, and quickly told his grandfather the ghost-catching mission assigned by the underworld.

Anyway, he had already suffered the punishment for leaking the underworld before, so he didn't care about it now. Let the old man help him make an idea first, which was the top priority.

After hearing this, the old man's face became serious, and his fingertips gently rubbed the table. He was also very cautious about his grandson's first sight of a ghost.

After he touched his chin and thought for a moment, his eyes suddenly lit up and he patted his thigh: "Xiao Jiang, did the ancestor of the City God tell us when he would be promoted to be the City God of the Prefecture?"

Wu Jiang thought about it carefully and shook his head: "My ancestor only said that he would be promoted soon, but did not say the specific time."

"Then this is enough!" The old man cheered up, "The efficiency of work in the underworld may not be much faster than that in the earth. It has only been a week, and the ancestor must not have left yet! Let's go and beg him again. No matter what, we have to ask him to give you some means to save your life!"
